subject: Adding clean option for build script and fixing current clippy issues (#67)
reason: The change is build/CI and documentation only: a `clean` subcommand added to build.sh, a README note for it, and re-indentation of doc comments in src/bloom/utils.rs to fix a clippy doc-formatting lint. No executable Rust code changes — the module's commands, replies, serialization, and configs are identical to the parent — so there is no behaviour for a scenario to exercise.
